subject: ddl/ingest: close writer before engine (#54569)
summary: This commit only changes the cleanup lifecycle for local-disk ingest engines: it closes all cached Lightning local writers before calling `OpenedEngine.Close()`, avoiding writer close/flush paths running after the engine has been transitioned to closed state. The blast radius is limited to ingest cleanup behavior; it does not change add-index import/flush semantics or any DDL metadata/state-machine transitions. Upstream/master later keeps the same ordering and further hardens cleanup to run even when engine close fails.
